schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

customManagers.description: Node version of the Docker image, set through ARG NODE_VERSION

packageRules.description: Bundle minor and patch updates of dev tooling into a single PR
Keep @types/node on the Node major the Docker image runs

Hold the OpenTelemetry SDK on 2.x until @vercel/otel supports SDK 3: its peer ranges stop at resources/sdk-metrics/sdk-trace-base <3 and sdk-logs/api-logs <0.300, and SDK 3 needs @opentelemetry/api 1.10
Same hold for the 0.x side of the OpenTelemetry SDK (see above)

prBodyNotes: The Prisma client is committed under `prisma/generated`: run `pnpm db:generate` against a local database and commit the result before merging.

packageRules.description: Held below 0.57: ServerBlockNoteEditor 0.57 assigns window and document to globalThis on first render and never removes them, without Element & co. Code that sniffs `typeof window` then breaks server-wide (prismjs, loaded by the email templates in auth.ts, throws 'Element is not defined'). Lift once upstream stops leaking the globals.
